name: fix101_weapon_switch
verifies: fix-101 (owner: switching from the bow to the sword reacts slowly): a quick-slot key switches like G3 CP 1.75 — the held weapon is put away to the end, the new one drawn in the same frame (bow -> 1H, 1H -> bow 1.52 s, 1H -> spell 1.32 s, 1H <-> 2H 1.52 s, standing); a key pressed during the bow's reload, during a melee attack, while drawing the string or with the aim held is not lost: it waits for G3's next loop state (one-slot action queue: the full draw, the reload's end, the move's end) and acts in that frame, the aim ends without a shot; the hero killed while drawing the bow lies dead with empty hands (G3 Kill -> DropHandItems -> HoldStacks(-1,-1)) under the game-over text GO_GameOver (Конец)
notes: G3 numbers (WeaponSwitchTimeline, motion data checked by Tools/G3Tests HeroWeaponSwitchTimelineTests): bow HoldLeft 0.40 + 0.36 s, 1H HoldRight 0.20 + 0.56, 2H/staff/fist 0.36 + 0.40, spell 0.28 + 0.28; a switch = put-away pair + draw pair, the draw starts in the tick the put-away ends. Each switchtrace line logs taken / old weapon off the hand / put away / draw / new weapon in the hand / ready, the join in frames (must be 0) and G3's line; FAIL above G3 + 0.1 s or when a waiting key does not act as the body is free. Before fix-101 the reload, attack and aim lines were REFUSED (the key was lost) and the join was 1 frame.
